stem.text: The graph shows the changes that occur in the concentration of antibodies in the blood of a baby before birth and during the first few months after birth.

stem.alt: Graph of concentration of antibodies in blood of baby against time in months, with curves labelled total antibodies, antibodies made by baby and antibodies from mother, and a dashed line at birth.

stem.text: Which description about the changes in immunity during the first few months after birth is correct?

A.text: active artificial immunity decreases, active natural immunity increases

B.text: active natural immunity decreases, active artificial immunity increases

C.text: passive artificial immunity decreases, active natural immunity increases

D.text: passive natural immunity decreases, active natural immunity increases
